whph.description: WHPH local MCP server (Streamable HTTP, IPv4 loopback only) exposing user-authorized WHPH actions. Disabled by default: enable it in WHPH Settings, create a named connection with the needed scopes, and export the one-time token as WHPH_MCP_TOKEN in mcps/.env. Use the port shown in Settings if it differs from 44041. WHPH must keep running. Bridged to stdio via mcp-remote because agent-ctrl does not render HTTP headers.
